reasons.vm_not_found: VM not found (check the UUID in power.conf)
reasons.target_starting: Waiting for the server to be ready
reasons.ssh_host_untrusted: SSH host key of the server not confirmed (twinraid-admin trust-host-key target)
reasons.ssh_host_key_mismatch: SSH host key of the server has changed – check it and confirm it again

retry.paused: Next attempt at {{time}}. Once the cause is fixed, TwinRaid connects right away after a successful “twinraid-admin trust-host-key target” in the container console.

notices.target_connect_plugin: The Unraid Connect plugin is installed on {{target}}. It connects the server to the Unraid cloud; with Flash Backup an unencrypted copy of the USB stick would be stored there, including the SSH host keys of the server.
notices.target_flash_backup: Flash Backup of Unraid Connect is active on {{target}}.
notices.vm_name_mismatch: The VM from power.conf on {{target}} has a different name than gaming_vm.unraid_vm_name. Please check the UUID in power.conf.
notices.source_connect_plugin: The Unraid Connect plugin is installed on {{target}}. Its boot medium holds the “sync” key (from v0.5.1); with Flash Backup an unencrypted copy of it would be in Unraid's cloud.
notices.source_flash_backup: Unraid Connect Flash Backup is active on {{target}}.
notices.source_guard_allows_self: The guard's allow list on {{target}} contains TwinRaid's container. Check source-guard.conf: TwinRaid is never stopped.

connection.title: Connection to {{name}}
connection.description: How TwinRaid talks to the server.
connection.ssh: Status and VM actions run over SSH through guard.sh on {{name}} (keys “status” and “power”). TwinRaid needs no Unraid API key.
connection.webgui: The WebGUI is only used for the online check (connecting to webgui.port); whether Unraid uses HTTPS there does not matter.

caChange.failed: The acknowledgement failed. Please try again.

actions.requestFailed: The request failed. Please try again.

shutdown.title: Shut down {{target}}?
shutdown.description: Unraid stops containers, VMs and the array and switches the server off. Use “Wake” to switch it on again.

shutdownWithVm.title: Shut down the VM first?
shutdownWithVm.description: {{vm}} is running. TwinRaid shuts down the VM first and then {{target}}. If the VM does not react, TwinRaid stops and the server keeps running.

vmStop.title: Shut down {{vm}}?
vmStop.description_one: The VM receives the shutdown signal, like a short press of the power button. If it does not react within {{count}} minute, “Force off” becomes possible.
vmStop.description_other: The VM receives the shutdown signal, like a short press of the power button. If it does not react within {{count}} minutes, “Force off” becomes possible.

force.title: Switch {{vm}} off immediately?
force.description: The VM is switched off at once, like pulling the power plug. Unsaved data in the VM is lost.

forceAndShutdown.title: Force {{vm}} off and then shut down {{target}}?
forceAndShutdown.description: Warning: forcing is like pulling the power plug of the VM. It is switched off at once without shutting down. Unsaved data in the VM is lost, running Windows updates are interrupted. Then TwinRaid shuts down {{target}} cleanly. If the VM still stays on, the server keeps running.
forceAndShutdown.confirm: Force VM off and shut down server

hints.checkShutdown: Please look at the web interface of the server.

guard.active_other: Guard: active · heartbeat {{age}} s ago · {{count}} containers allowed

errors.config_invalid: Guard: source-guard.conf is invalid; it accepts no orders.
errors.misconfigured: Guard: the folders under /run/twinraid-source-guard are not usable; it accepts no orders.
errors.request_not_a_file: Guard: the order file is unusable; it accepts no orders.
errors.state_lost: The guard lost its state (private/ is missing). Check the containers it had stopped in Unraid and start them by hand; then run source-guard.sh restart.
errors.docker_unavailable: Guard: Docker is not reachable on {{source}}; it tries again every 5 seconds.

errorDetails.missing_file: source-guard.conf is missing or is a symlink.
errorDetails.bad_owner: source-guard.conf is not owned by root.
errorDetails.syntax: A line is not of the form “key value”.
errorDetails.bad_value: A value is invalid or out of range.
errorDetails.forbidden_dataset: system and domains are never mirrored.
errorDetails.too_many: Too many entries (allow and deny at most 50 together, dataset at most 20).
errorDetails.allow_contains_twinraid: allow contains TwinRaid itself; the guard never stops TwinRaid.
errorDetails.in_unexpected_content: /run/twinraid-source-guard/in contains something unexpected; the guard does not mount a tmpfs there.
errorDetails.mount_failed: The tmpfs for the order file could not be mounted.
errorDetails.in_wrong_mount: Something other than the guard's own tmpfs is mounted on /run/twinraid-source-guard/in.
errorDetails.request_create_failed: The order file could not be created.
errorDetails.request_is_directory: There is a directory in place of the order file (TwinRaid started before the guard).
errorDetails.request_is_symlink: The order file is a symlink.
errorDetails.request_not_regular: The order file is not a regular file.
errorDetails.request_bad_owner: The order file is not owned by root.
errorDetails.request_hardlink: The order file has more than one hard link.

setup.state_not_mounted: Guard mounted incorrectly: the template lacks the path for the status (/srv/worker/source-guard/state).
setup.request_not_mounted: Guard mounted incorrectly: the template lacks the path for the order file (/srv/worker/source-guard/request).
setup.state_writable: Guard mounted incorrectly: the status is mounted writable; set it to “Read Only” in the template.
setup.request_read_only: Guard mounted incorrectly: the order file is mounted read-only; set it to “Read/Write” in the template.
setup.request_is_directory: There is a directory in place of the order file because TwinRaid started before the guard. Start the guard, then restart TwinRaid (steps in docs/EINRICHTUNG.md).
setup.request_not_regular: Guard mounted incorrectly: the order file is not a regular file.

statusProblems.not_regular: status.json is not a regular file.
statusProblems.schema: status.json does not have the expected structure.
statusProblems.protocol_mismatch: The guard speaks another protocol; copy the source-guard.sh that matches this version of TwinRaid.
statusProblems.heartbeat_future: The heartbeat lies in the future; check the server's clock.

runEnds.deadman_heartbeat: The last run ended at {{time}} by the dead man's switch: TwinRaid stopped reporting.

zfs.unavailable: ZFS not available: mainpool is missing or zfs does not respond.
zfs.compressionOff: Compression is off for mainpool/{{name}}. In Unraid, choose “Compression on” in the pool settings.

selfDataset.outside: TwinRaid's /config or /data are not in mainpool/appdata/twinraid; the guard therefore does not send appdata (test Z4).

selfDataset.unknown: Whether TwinRaid's own dataset exists is unknown right now.

settings.description: Stops the allowed containers on {{name}} for the sync and starts them again. TwinRaid only reads its status; what is allowed is set in source-guard.conf on {{name}}.
settings.noDetails: No current status from the guard.
